step.label: Evaluate supplier and material sources
step.description: Source optimal materials and vendors from the enterprise catalog to meet procurement requirements.
step.useCase: Procurement teams identify approved suppliers and component options before purchase orders.

step.label: Enrich customer order context
step.description: Augment incoming customer orders with account history and order enrichment data to ensure fulfillment accuracy.
step.useCase: Sales operations teams contextualize customer orders with account details to improve fulfillment speed.

step.label: Validate hazardous material compliance
step.description: Check inbound materials against hazardous substance inventory to ensure safety and regulatory compliance.
step.useCase: Safety teams prevent non-compliant hazardous materials from entering inventory.

step.label: Receive and register inbound materials
step.description: Record material receipt in inventory management system with vendor and material master data validation.
step.useCase: Inventory teams update stock levels and material locations upon delivery verification.

step.label: Assess incident impact on fulfillment
step.description: Review incident resolution metrics to identify service disruptions affecting order fulfillment operations.
step.useCase: Operations managers monitor unresolved incidents that may delay material or order processing.

step.label: Orchestrate engineering changes to resources
step.description: Coordinate equipment modifications and process changes required to support new material specifications or customer requirements.
step.useCase: Engineering teams implement material or process changes to maintain fulfillment capability.

step.label: Manage equipment and service requests
step.description: Track equipment changes and maintenance service tickets to ensure production systems remain operational for fulfillment.
step.useCase: IT Service Management ensures manufacturing equipment stays operational for order fulfillment.

step.label: Align workforce compensation with fulfillment capacity
step.description: Review employee compensation structures to ensure adequate staffing levels and incentives for fulfillment demand.
step.useCase: Finance and HR teams ensure labor costs and staffing align with forecasted order fulfillment volumes.
